description: Poll the component tree until an element matching the given testID or accessibilityLabel appears. Returns element info on success. Use after tap_element, navigate(), or any action that triggers async screen transitions or data loading — instead of immediately calling the next tool. Returns traversal metadata immediately when the bounded search is incomplete.

maxDepth.description: Maximum fiber depth inspected per poll

pollInterval.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default 500)

selector.description: testID or accessibilityLabel to wait for

name: wait_for_element
